paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: Analysis plot of the number of tweets corresponding to the number of sentiments.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of tweets associated with a given number of sentiments related to COVID-19 vaccines. The horizontal axis represents the number of labels, ranging from 0 to 5, with evenly spaced integer values. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of tweets", uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40000, and displays tick labels every 100000 tweets. There are four bars depicted, colored in shades of red-orange, green, and maroon. The tallest bar, colored red-orange, represents 0 labels and has an approximate height corresponding to a value of 400000 tweets. The second tallest bar, colored green, represents 1 label and reaches approximately 375000 tweets. The third bar, colored maroon, corresponds to 2 labels and has a height approximated at 125000 tweets. The final and shortest bar, also maroon, represents 3 labels and has an approximate height of approximately 75000 tweets. The bars are not visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations and they are arranged in ascending order according to the number of labels on the horizontal axis.
